#### Clase `TestWithCExtension` (Línea 333)
- **Docstring:** _Sin docstring._
- **Métodos:**
  - `def _simulate_package_with_extension(self, tmp_path)` (Línea 334): Sin docstring.
  - `def test_skip_discovery_with_setupcfg_metadata(self, tmp_path)` (Línea 367): Ensure that auto-discovery is not triggered when the project is based on
C-extensions only, for backward compatibility.
  - `def test_dont_skip_discovery_with_pyproject_metadata(self, tmp_path)` (Línea 395): When opting-in to pyproject.toml metadata, auto-discovery will be active if
the package lists C-extensions, but does not configure py-modules or packages.

This way we ensure users with complex package layouts that would lead to the
discovery of multiple top-level modules/packages see errors and are forced to
explicitly set ``packages`` or ``py-modules``.
